name: WhoisFreaks WHOIS API (historical and reverse WHOIS)
tier_rationale: Small company with public API documentation, an error table, a credit ledger and paid plans (A8 community); P022 chair rationale: 'Whoxy and WhoisFreaks are small companies'.

reliability.justification: Third-party WHOIS crawl and history; post-GDPR records are mostly redacted and registry data stays authoritative.

error_markers.reason: WhoisFreaks: API credits or subscription exhausted (could not verify)
WhoisFreaks: the key was blocked for suspicious activity (could not verify)
WhoisFreaks: TLD not served or inactive (HTTP 403, could not verify)

whoisfreaks.description: WhoisFreaks API key (historical 2 credits per query, reverse 5 credits per page), sent as ?apiKey= and masked by the central redactor (AR01)
whoisfreaks.plan_hint: business = a company-paid WhoisFreaks plan recorded with the purchase in licence_allow (P022 cond 1); never an analyst's personal free credits

api.title: WhoisFreaks API v1.0 /whois?whois=historical (2 credits) and ?whois=reverse&email=|owner=|company=&exact=true&mode=mini (5 credits per page)

terms.quote: Company-paid keys only; legal records the licence/purchase in licence_allow before an adapter runs under corporate (P022 cond 1). Terms 'license' (paid credits).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P022 cond 1, chair rationale). Research C0054: keyless answers HTTP 400 {"status":400,"error":"Invalid Param Exception","message":"Please provide apikey"} (real fixture), mapped to NEEDS_KEY by the module (P022 cond 7). Documented status table (whoisfreaks.com/documentation/errors): 401 invalid/inactive key -> NEEDS_KEY; 401 buy plan/credits, 412, 413 -> QUOTA; 401 suspicious activity -> could not verify; 403 TLD not served; 404 'No Record Found' -> documented absence; 408/499/504 timeout; 429 per-minute limit. WhoisFreaks documents the key only as a query parameter (?apiKey=), so the central redactor rule applies here too (AR01). Used by whois_history_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-2 (P022 whois_history_keyed). Cache 30 days (P022 cond 7). min_interval 2 s (per-minute plan limit). The quota block is a request budget; the module also keeps a monthly credit budget per adapter (history 2, reverse 5 credits per page).
